purpose: Teach: びん/左足/トホホ/デブ/キュート/フレンドリー/カミさん/姑

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お醤油のびんが割れちゃって、お父さんが片付けて下さってるわ
lines.en: Sho, the soy sauce bottle broke. Your dad is cleaning it up.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone with a gentle undertone. Speaks as if explaining something ordinary that doesn't need fuss. Open, unremarkable cadence—she's informing, not alarming.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、サッカーで左足を打っちゃったよ
lines.en: Mom, I kicked my left foot during soccer practice.
lines.style: Quiet, careful delivery. Small voice but steady—not complaining, reporting. Slight tension under the surface, like he's waiting to see if this is a problem. Hesitant pause before the verb.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、それはトホホな結果ね、お父さんに見せて
lines.en: Oh no, Sho. Let your dad take a look at it.
lines.style: Light, wry concern mixed with practical reassurance. Gentle sympathetic undertone beneath the slight tease. Not worried enough to fuss, but attentive enough to send him to check.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、最近デブになりすぎないように気を付けてるよ
lines.en: Mom, I've been careful about not getting too heavy lately.
lines.style: Soft, tentative voice. He's sharing something that matters to him but unsure if it's the right thing to mention. Pause before the main clause, like he's checking himself. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、その絵、本当にキュートに描けてるわよ
lines.en: Sho, that picture turned out really nicely. You drew it well.
lines.style: Warm approval without overdoing it. Specific praise—she's noticed the effort. Easy, natural cadence, like complimenting something she genuinely saw.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しいクラスのみんな、フレンドリーで嬉しいよ
lines.en: That makes me happy, Sho—your new classmates are being nice to you.
lines.style: Genuine delight in his happiness. Soft, open tone. A small rise at the recognition of his good fortune. Present and listening, not just responding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「カミさん」って私を呼んで下さるのよ
lines.en: Your dad calls me 'Kami-san,' you know. It's kind of funny.
lines.style: Dry warmth. Light, knowing tone—she finds it endearing and slightly ridiculous at once. Relaxed, intimate delivery, like sharing a small joke with him. Easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃん、つまり姑さんが明日いらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother—your dad's mother—is coming tomorrow.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact but with a note of gentle preparation in her voice. She's giving him advance notice, not a surprise. Steady pacing, slight emphasis on the relationship clarification. Quiet and knowing.
